summary:
This repo is a React + Vite account-signup demo (`src/pages/Signup.jsx`, `Login.jsx`, `Welcome.jsx`, shared CSS in `src/style.css`). There is no Angular, no `AppModule`/NgModule, no Bootstrap 4, no navbar/footer, no tutorials entity, and no `src/index.html` or `src/styles.css`. I took the smaller reading: apply item 4's visual polish to the app that actually exists here, rather than inventing a tutorials app.

- `index.html` (this project's entry HTML, repo root): linked the Inter Google font with preconnects.
- `src/style.css` (the shared stylesheet): one consistent indigo scheme with reusable tokens (radius, spacing gap, easing), a light grey page background, Inter as the base family, softer card shadow and rounded inputs with a focus glow, and smooth hover transitions on inputs, buttons and links.

No component logic, store or routing changed; no test files exist in this repo, so there were none to update.
blockers: Not applied -- 1. HeaderComponent in src/app/components/header/ declared in AppModule, gradient navbar, Tutorial Manager logo, Tutorials/Add Tutorial links, footer: Describes an Angular/NgModule tutorials app that does not exist in this React + Vite signup repo; there is no navbar, AppModule or tutorials entity to restyle and I would have had to invent the application
Not applied -- 2. Tutorials list card grid, search bar, status pills, empty state, red Remove All button: No tutorials list page or service exists in this repository

Not applied -- 3. Add/Edit tutorial pages as centered cards with Bootstrap alerts: No Add/Edit pages exist here; Bootstrap 4 is not a dependency of this project and the instruction forbids changing package.json
Not applied -- Link font in src/index.html and shared styles in src/styles.css: Those paths do not exist here; the equivalents are the root index.html and src/style.css, which I edited instead
Not applied -- Update the existing component tests to match: This repository contains no test files

visual_check.evidence: The /signup page renders in Inter on a light grey page background with a centered white rounded card, soft shadow, rounded inputs and a full-width indigo 'Sign up' button — the item-4 visual polish (font, background, consistent colour scheme and spacing) is visibly applied. Items 1-3 describe an Angular/Bootstrap tutorials app that does not exist in this React repo, so nothing was expected there; the password rules list is absent under the password field, but that is pre-existing on this branch and untouched by a CSS/font-only change.

context_sharing.notes: This is a client-only React/Vite app with no HTTP API: index.html and src/style.css contain no network calls, and all persistence goes through src/store.js using localStorage key 'acme-users' (map keyed by lowercased, trimmed email) and sessionStorage key 'acme-current'. Client routes handled by src/router.jsx via location.pathname are /signup, /login, and /welcome — these are page paths, not API endpoints.
